title: San Francisco Weekend with Unexpected Plus-One

scenario.description: A solo weekend getaway to San Francisco. Mid-planning, the traveler's partner decides to join the trip, requiring additional flight tickets, a hotel room capacity check, and dining reservation updates.

dynamic_events.description: Your partner just cleared their schedule and will join you on this trip. Your total party size is now 2 adults. Your new combined budget is $2200. You must book an additional ticket on the exact same flights, ensure your hotel room can accommodate two people, and update all restaurant reservations to a table for two.
resolution_requirements: Add a second passenger to the existing outbound and return flights
Verify or upgrade the hotel booking to ensure the room capacity is at least 2
Modify all existing restaurant reservations from 1 person to 2 people
Ensure the new total cost for two people stays under the new $2200 budget

expected_challenges: Agent must handle an entity count mutation (from 1 to 2) across multiple independent bookings.
Checking if the selected flights still have a second seat available, and if the hotel room type allows 2 guests.
Managing a dynamic budget increase alongside the entity increase.
notes: Tests quantity mutation. The agent must update the parameters of already-booked API calls without arbitrarily changing the venues or flight times unless necessary.
